geometry_diagnostic.status: current assumed model cannot reach documented width
geometry_diagnostic.method: Binary search of trajectory.ray() to the neck-aperture boundary; 0.2, 0.1 and 0.05 mm integration steps agree on half-width within 1 nm.
geometry_diagnostic.evidence: design-derived from documented width and explicitly assumed geometry; not a physical B31G22 measurement
geometry_diagnostic.conclusion: The current 10 mm neck aperture clips the beam before the 210 mm documented width. Increasing the assumed neck radius to 12 mm would permit the width, but the current horizontal winding inner radius is 11.5 mm, so the tube and yoke geometry must be revised together before peak current is frozen.
